scenes.title: Simple and Compound Nouns
scenes.summary: Nouns simple and double, and even triple, like many of the Massaliots', Hermocaicoxanthus.

scenes.title: Eight Kinds of Noun
scenes.summary: Standard, rare, metaphor, ornament, coined, lengthened, shortened, altered: sigynon is standard in Cyprus and a rare word for us.

scenes.title: Four Kinds of Metaphor
scenes.summary: From genus to species ("My ship stands over there"), species to genus ("countless good deeds"), species to species (Empedocles), and by analogy.

scenes.title: Metaphor by Analogy
scenes.summary: The cup of Dionysus and the shield of Ares, old age as the evening of life, sowing the god-created flame, the wineless cup.

scenes.title: Coined, Lengthened, Shortened, Altered
scenes.summary: Ernyges and arētēr; polēos and Pēlēiadeō; kri and dō; dexiteron for dexion.

scenes.title: The Genders of Nouns
scenes.summary: The endings of masculine, feminine and in-between nouns.
